metadata.title: Gujarat Environment, Climate, Sanctuaries & Disaster Vulnerability

properties.name: Seismic Zone V (Very High Damage Risk — Z = 0.36)
properties.districts_covered: Kachchh District (Bhuj, Anjar, Gandhidham, Bhachau, Rapar)
properties.active_faults: Kutch Mainland Fault, Allah Bund Fault, Katrol Hill Fault, Island Belt Fault
properties.historical_events: 2001 Bhuj Earthquake (Mw 7.7), 1819 Rann of Kutch Earthquake (Mw 7.8)
properties.design_code: BIS IS 1893:2016 Part 1 & IS 13920 Ductile Detailing Mandatory
properties.source_org: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS IS 1893) & GSDMA

properties.name: Seismic Zone IV (High Damage Risk — Z = 0.24)
properties.districts_covered: Ahmedabad, Patan, Morbi, Surendranagar, Jamnagar, Rajkot, Bharuch
properties.active_faults: Narmada-Son Fault, Cambay Rift Basin Fault, West Coast Fault
properties.design_code: BIS IS 1893:2016 High Ductility Design Mandatory
properties.source_org: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS IS 1893) & GSDMA

properties.name: Seismic Zone III (Moderate Damage Risk — Z = 0.16)
properties.districts_covered: Vadodara, Surat, Valsad, Navsari, Dang, Tapi, Anand, Kheda, Bhavnagar
properties.active_faults: Tapi Rift Fault, Deccan Volcanic Basement Fractures
properties.design_code: BIS IS 1893:2016 Standard Seismic Resilient Construction
properties.source_org: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS IS 1893) & GSDMA

properties.name: Saurashtra & Kutch Very High Cyclone Vulnerability Zone
properties.surge_risk: Very High (3.0 to 5.5m Storm Surge Potential)
properties.historical_cyclones: Cyclone Tauktae (2021, Cat 4, 220 km/h), Cyclone Biparjoy (2023), 1998 Kandla Cyclone
properties.districts_covered: Gir Somnath, Porbandar, Devbhumi Dwarka, Jamnagar, Kutch

properties.name: Gulf of Khambhat Funneling & High Surge Zone
properties.historical_cyclones: Cyclone Vayu (2019), Cyclone Nisarga (2020 near-miss), 1982 Saurashtra Cyclone

properties.name: South Gujarat Coastal Wind Zone
properties.historical_cyclones: Seasonal Arabian Sea depressions and heavy monsoon gales

properties.name: Tapi River Floodplain & Surat Urban Inundation Zone
properties.historical_floods: 2006 Flood (9.1 lakh cusecs release, 75% city flooded), 1998 Flood, 1968 Flood
properties.mitigation: Ukai Dam reservoir moderation rule curves & Surat embankment walls

properties.name: Vishwamitri River & Vadodara Flash Flood Zone
properties.historical_floods: 2019, 2014, 1994, 2005 Inundations caused by Ajwa reservoir overflow (214 ft FRL)
properties.mitigation: Vishwamitri Riverfront Cleanliness & Flood Barrier Sluice Gates

properties.name: Narmada Downstream & Bharuch-Ankleshwar Lowland Flood Zone
properties.historical_floods: September 2023 (>18 lakh cusecs combined spillway), 2020, 2013 high flows
properties.mitigation: Golden Bridge monitoring mark (24 ft warning, 28 ft danger mark)

properties.name: Banas River & North Gujarat Flash Flood Zone
properties.historical_floods: July 2017 Mega Floods (Dantiwada & Sipu overflow), 2015 Floods
properties.mitigation: Suflam Suflam spreading canal and check dam cascading

properties.name: Gir National Park & Wildlife Sanctuary
properties.designation: National Park & Wildlife Sanctuary (Asiatic Lion Sanctuary)
properties.key_species: Asiatic Lion (Panthera leo leo - sole wild habitat), Leopard, Chital, Sambar

properties.name: Marine National Park & Sanctuary (Gulf of Kutch)
properties.designation: Marine National Park (First Marine Park of India)
properties.key_species: Coral Reefs (52 species), Mangroves, Dugong, Dolphin, Whale Shark

properties.name: Blackbuck National Park (Velavadar)
properties.key_species: Blackbuck (Antilope cervicapra), Indian Wolf, Striped Hyena, Lesser Florican

properties.name: Wild Ass Sanctuary (Little Rann of Kutch)
properties.key_species: Indian Wild Ass (Equus hemionus khur - sole world habitat), Greater Flamingo

properties.name: Nal Sarovar Bird Sanctuary (Ramsar Wetland Site #2078)
properties.key_species: Migratory Waterfowl, Rosy Pelican, Flamingo, Common Crane (250+ bird species)

properties.name: Vansda National Park
properties.designation: National Park (Western Ghats moist deciduous forest)
properties.key_species: Leopard, Rusty-spotted cat, Four-horned antelope, Giant Squirrel
